name: probitas
description: Sourced counterparty dossiers and repeat-run comparisons.

interface.shortDescription: Sourced counterparty dossiers and repeat-run comparisons.
interface.longDescription: Probitas takes an entity name and addresses the counterparty declared, then builds a sourced dossier of borrowing, repayment, and what could not be established across supported venues. It can compare two gate-checkable evidence files for the same subject without claiming that their differences prove chronology. A deterministic collector writes the evidence; a gate checker requires every narrative figure and assertion to trace to it and keeps unchecked venues visible. It does not discover hidden addresses, identify a legal person, score the borrower, set terms, or make the decision. Morpho Midnight secondary-market borrow exits remain unattributable and its curation data remains uncollected.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $probitas to build a sourced dossier from declared addresses or compare two Probitas evidence files for the same entity.
